headlines.text: 2024 brought us this moment: John Silver returned to the fold after 6 weeks away, appearing on Rampage.
Flash back to 2022, when Bear Bronson made their long-awaited return to AEW television after just under 7 months away, appearing on Dynamite.

That Wednesday in 2022, Sammy Guevara vs. Daniel Garcia put the AEW Interim TNT Title on the line, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.75. For Daniel Garcia, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.

secondaries.text: Turning the clock back to 2024: Hikaru Shida vs. Queen Aminata locked horns for the first time on Rampage, rated 6.96.
It was 2024 when Eddie Kingston vs. Wheeler Yuta went to battle over the ROH World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.56.
Looking back to 2022, when it was the first-ever encounter between Penta El Zero M and Matt Hardy on Dynamite, rated 5.04.
